how: We read the website of every Indianapolis wedding videographer listed on Lazo (46 listings, 34 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Chicago studio listed under Westfield, corporate video and marketing houses, a maternity and boudoir studio, a venue, a DJ, a national franchise page and a 24-hour content-creation service; only eight sites were plainly wedding film businesses. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How is audio captured for the vows and toasts: lapel mics, a feed from the DJ, or just the camera?
When do the highlight film and the full-length edit arrive, and are raw files or the full ceremony included?
Have you filmed at a barn outside the city with no house lighting, and a winter wedding held entirely indoors? Ask to see one of each.

picks.name: Fret & Frame Films
picks.blurb: Sentimental wedding films that aim to preserve the rhythm of the day, from hands trembling before a first look to the best friend's toast that has the room in stitches. Fret & Frame is based in Indianapolis, works beyond it, and frames its films as family heirlooms.

picks.name: NWP Films
picks.blurb: More than 13 years of documenting weddings with a cinematic-meets-journalistic approach, on the premise that a wedding is a celebration, not a photoshoot. NWP Films makes wedding films and photos from Indianapolis, and does not stage moments.

picks.name: IndyVisual
picks.blurb: A full-time video production studio filming weddings, corporate and music projects since 1993. Founder Bob Ridge has Indiana University degrees in telecommunications and psychology, won three ADDY Awards in television, and lists ILEA Esprit Award recognition among the world's top event filmmakers.

picks.name: Ralph Vandale Photography And Videography LLC
picks.blurb: Photo and films from one editorial-minded Indianapolis studio, with a luxury experience as the pitch and over seven years of weddings, celebrity work and bridal-publication features behind it. For couples who want the stills and the film to match.

picks.name: Sandhu wedding photography
picks.blurb: Cinematography alongside 20-plus years of Indian and Punjabi wedding photography, with a vibrant, cinematic storytelling style that the studio says reflects the heart of each wedding. Based in New Whiteland, with destination work.

picks.name: Kumar Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Sikh, Punjabi, Indian, Pakistani and South Asian wedding photography and videography from an Indiana base, with travel to the destination when needed. Kumar says the story that matters is real people and real moments, and also offers DJ and lighting services.

picks.name: BB Focus Visuals
picks.blurb: Bryce Bettag filmed his first wedding in college on borrowed gear, including a GoPro, and built BB Focus Visuals from there. Wedding and commercial video from Camby, serving Indianapolis, Greenwood, Plainfield, Carmel and Zionsville.

picks.name: Capture Hour Productions, LLC
picks.blurb: A Midwest video production company serving Chicago and Indianapolis that argues photos are beautiful but video is the reality of the day. Capture Hour films weddings alongside corporate events and offers multi-camera setups, drone footage and photography.
